description.de: "The greater the State becomes, the greater humanity under it flourishes."
description.en: "The greater the State becomes, the greater humanity under it flourishes."
description.es: «Cuanto más grande se vuelve el Estado, más grande es la humanidad que florece en él».
description.fr: « De la gloire de l'État dépend la grandeur de l'humanité. »
description.ja: 「連合の発展が、そこに所属する人類の繁栄をもたらす。」
description.ko: "연합이 더 위대해질수록, 그의 그늘 아래 더 위대한 인류가 번창하리라."
description.ru: "The greater the State becomes, the greater humanity under it flourishes."
description.zh: “国家越强大，其治下的人民才会越繁荣富强。”
